status: implemented locally; static maps current; engine/runtime/publication pending
objective: Ordinary Cancel consumed batch / stop requires an explicit current-batch loss decision before destroying consumed work.
ownership: C: cancellation callback and minimal scene-owned dialog/lifecycle handlers in base_demo.gd plus feature docs/maps. No production-domain or other-owner edits. Separate from frozen bay and count patches.

authorities.domain: Existing activity owns enabled/batch/receipt/work/output promise/history and cancel material rules.
authorities.ui: One scene-owned ConfirmationDialog and single-use pending request of identities only; not a second batch/history owner.
authorities.identity: Capture current simulation and session simulation, activity reference, selected duty/kind/id, actual recipe, and current consumed batch ID. Revalidate immediately before committing.

flow: Click resolves actual current activity. Empty batch follows existing cancel/stop command without a loss prompt.
Nonempty actual batch means consumed inputs under existing FixedProduction lifecycle. Read actual receipt quantities, recipe/output and facility name; no broad snapshot.

Opening records decision identity and displays explicit lost consumed ingredients/no refund/lost work/no unfinished output, finished goods stay; Keep/default focus and explicit Cancel batch and stop choices. Pause/resume stays separate.
Keep/Escape/close clears request with no game command/reconciliation, pause or price/resource change. Normal time may continue.

Confirm consumes pending request once; compare current model/session, selected context/activity, current recipe/batch ID. If stale, close/reject with Nothing was cancelled. Otherwise call captured activity.cancel once through existing _result.
events: One existing shared-state subscription goes through a thin handler retaining existing refresh plus pending-only scalar/object identity validation. Model replacement and real selection/recipe/control reload changes invalidate. No idle polling, timer, deferred query owner, cache or extra shared-state subscription.
lifecycle: Dialog and pending request owned by Base node. New session subscriptions disconnect on exit. Stale completion/replacement/selection never targets successor work. Existing recipe confirmation unchanged.

experience.title: Cancel active batch?
experience.loss: Actual consumed receipt item amounts not refunded; work lost; unfinished output not produced; finished goods remain. Keep and use Pause/resume to suspend.
experience.stale: The batch changed. Nothing was cancelled. Review the current batch and try again.

frozen_acceptance: An active consumed batch cannot be cancelled by the ordinary button before explicit confirmation.
Keep/dismiss performs no production mutation; no implicit pause/freeze.
Valid confirm targets captured same activity/recipe/batch once, preserving existing domain loss/stop semantics.
Session, selection, activity, recipe or batch replacement/completion cannot cancel different/new work; stale request is rejected/closed truthfully.
No active consumed batch uses existing stop path without pointless loss prompt; recipe-change confirmations and Pause behavior unchanged.
verification: Source review and required static map maintenance only in this local increment. No local engine, suite, broad scenario, failure injection, coverage matrix, benchmark, PR/check submission or publication. Runtime dialog/input/loss/physical output remain unverified.
references: GDD section6: cancellation of consumed work must explain loss before commitment.
Existing selectable recipe request/confirm token pattern and FixedProduction.cancel/HeavyProduction.cancel read directly.
review: UX consultation supplied exact loss/Keep/stale wording. Prospective design meaning is not final exact-head code approval; lead technical and Designer review required.
identity_detail: Session Node identity is captured and checked as well as model/activity/duty/context/actual recipe/batch ID; consume single-use request before validation/command.
